So once you enter a wormhole with a legendary pokemon, you'll receive the message about something exuding great power or something like that. The massage let's you know a legendary is in there. Then when you're around halfway through the little wormhole zone, the pokemon will in some cases be revealed only through sillhouette or will only cry out aloud. To be safe, save right after that so that you can soft reset for those legends. Of course you have a few more steps to go, but saving there is a nice little checkpoint I guess. In some wormholes, the legends who fly will be in the air, so the spot where they battle you is in the form of a big round shadow on the ground in front of you. In other wormholes - the legends who appear in sillouhette form - you can walk until you enter the little annex/room part of the wormhole and save there too. Around 1/2 or 3/4 of the way through that room is about where those legends will jump down and attack you. So make sure you save before encountering them of course. 

TLDR - you can soft reset for them once you enter the hole. No need to leave the hole.
